title: Occupancy
description: Occupancy breakdown and guest count for an accommodation stay.

adults.description: Number of adults occupying the accommodation unit.

children.description: Number of children occupying the accommodation unit.

child_ages.description: Ages of children occupying the accommodation unit. If present length(child_ages) MUST equal children.

total.description: Total number of occupants in the accommodation unit. If adults and/or children fields are specified, this MUST equal adults + children.
